record.question: Which one of the following statements about deposit works is inaccurate?
options: Whenever a deposit work is to be undertaken, an initial deposit shall be realised before incurring any liability.
The initial deposit will be 100% of the A/A and E/S of the work having completion period up to 6 months.
About 2.5% deposit shall be retained as reserve for adjustment against the last portion of the estimated expenditure.
Deposits received from a client department for its work may be diverted to other works if situation demands.
record.explanation: Deposit funds from a client cannot be diverted to other works.
